name: Loboc River
shortDescription: A scenic river known for its floating restaurant cruises and lush jungle scenery.
longDescription: The Loboc River winds through dense jungle in central Bohol and is best known for its floating restaurants that offer a leisurely cruise with live entertainment and a buffet lunch while surrounded by cliffs and lowland rainforest.

name: Anda White Beach
longDescription: powder-white beach on Bohol's eastern coast with clear turquoise waters.
heroImageUrl: Anda is one of Bohol's lesser-known beach destinations offering white sand and calm
entranceFee: clear waters ideal for swimming and snorkeling without the crowds found in more popular spots.

name: Blood Compact Shrine
shortDescription: A monument marking the 1565 friendship pact between Datu Sikatuna and Miguel Lopez de Legazpi.
longDescription: This historical marker commemorates one of the first international treaties of friendship in the Philippines between a local chieftain and a Spanish explorer.
